chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), or he said, 'one of our companions, from al-Rida (peace be upon him)'
He said: 'The Tabarzand sugar consumes the phlegm with a devouring consumption.'

key_terms.الطَّبَرْزَدُ: Tabarzand (a specific type of sugar from Tabaristan)

ai.seo_question: What are the medicinal benefits of Tabarzand sugar according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the specific medicinal efficacy of Tabarzand sugar in dissolving phlegm, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of utilizing natural remedies for health maintenance. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the integration of spiritual and physical well-being, where dietary choices are viewed through the lens of divine wisdom and bodily purification.
